actionSteps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Use the tracker to find the unchecked rows.
Finish the last one; the platinum pops immediately.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.walkthrough: The platinum is the receipt, not a task: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work the roadmap in order — story first, the Chapter 1 meditation second, then stunts, map sweep and side activities — and this pops last. If it has not popped, the tracker shows exactly which rows are still unchecked.

actionSteps: Start a new game and play the opening.
Follow the mission prompts through Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.walkthrough: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first story trophy and it cannot be missed. Play through the introduction until the mission completes; the trophy pops at the mission end screen. It also opens the fishing activity used later for Baited My Tackle.

actionSteps: Play Chapter 1 story missions in order.
Do the balcony meditation with Lucia before leaving Chapter 1.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.walkthrough: Chapter 1 ends when its final story mission completes, so just play the story in order. Before the chapter closes, do the one missable thing in the game: meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house right after Down to Earth (see Positive Mental Attitude). Then finish the chapter and this trophy pops.

actionSteps: Play Chapter 2 story missions in order.
Try side activities as they unlock.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.walkthrough: Chapter 2 is pure story: play its missions in order and the trophy pops when the chapter ends. There is nothing missable here, so take the time to try side activities as they unlock — they feed the later phases. New stranger strands and businesses open up during this chapter.

actionSteps: Play Chapter 3 story missions in order.
Explore new zones as the map opens.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.walkthrough: Chapter 3 continues the story into Vice City proper, with more of the map and more activities opening up. Play the missions in order; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. This is a good chapter to start the map sweep habits — exploring new zones as they open counts toward The Goodtime State.

actionSteps: Play Chapter 4 story missions in order.
Clear waiting strand missions between story beats.
Complete the chapter's final mission.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.walkthrough: Chapter 4 is the penultimate story chapter. Play its missions in order and the trophy pops when the chapter ends. By now the stranger strands should be well advanced — if Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone or Bret have missions waiting, clear them between story beats so their finales are ready.

actionSteps: Finish Chapter 5 story missions in order.
Complete the final mission.
Continue in free roam for the remaining trophies.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.walkthrough: The gold story trophy: finish the final mission of Chapter 5 and the credits roll. It is unmissable and story-gated, so no preparation is needed beyond reaching the end. After the finale, free roam continues, so every post-story trophy (stunts, collectibles, activities) can be finished at leisure.

actionSteps: Advance the story until Breakfast Run appears.
Play the mission to completion.
The trophy pops at the mission end.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.walkthrough: Breakfast Run is a named story mission in the early chapters. It unlocks as the story advances; play the story in order and take the mission when it appears on the map. The trophy pops the moment the mission completes.

actionSteps: Advance the story until The Cartel Heist appears.
Complete any setup the mission asks for.
Finish the heist.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.walkthrough: The Cartel Heist is a named story mission that unlocks in the mid-game. It is a heist setup and execution, so expect a longer mission with a planning beat first. Follow the mission prompts, finish the heist, and the trophy pops at completion.

actionSteps: Advance the story until Child's Play appears.
Play the mission to completion.
The trophy pops at the mission end.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.walkthrough: Child's Play is a named story mission. It appears on the map as the story advances; there is no side requirement. Play it through to the end and the trophy pops at the mission complete screen.

actionSteps: Advance the story until Headliners appears.
Play the mission to completion.
The trophy pops at the mission end.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.walkthrough: Headliners is a named story mission in the later chapters. It unlocks through story progress alone. Take the mission marker when it appears, play it through, and the trophy pops on completion.

actionSteps: Advance the story until VCIA Takedown appears.
Play the mission to completion.
The trophy pops at the mission end.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.walkthrough: VCIA Takedown is a named story mission set around the airport. It unlocks as the story advances into the later chapters. Play the mission through — expect an action-heavy sequence at the airport — and the trophy pops when it completes.

actionSteps: Advance the story until Operation Savage Glory appears.
Stock up, then play the mission to completion.
The trophy pops at the mission end.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.walkthrough: Operation Savage Glory is a named story mission in the late game. It is a large set-piece mission, so go in with full health and ammo. Complete it and the trophy pops at the mission end.

actionSteps: Finish the story and all six character strands.
Clear the collectible sweep and the counted challenges.
Check in-game stats for the remaining percentage, then close it out.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.walkthrough: 100% completion is the sum of everything: all story missions, all stranger strands, all activities, all collectibles and all the counted challenges. The in-game stats page shows the percentage and what is missing, so check it whenever the number stalls. It is the last gold before the platinum and it cannot be rushed — it is the whole game.

actionSteps: Find stunt jumps on the map in free roam.
Hit each jump at speed and land it cleanly.
Repeat until the counter reaches 250 of 397.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.walkthrough: There are 397 stunt jumps scattered across Leonida and this trophy needs 250 of them. A stunt counts when you hit the jump and land it — airtime and a clean landing both matter, so use fast cars and bikes on the marked ramps. Work them region by region in free roam after the story; the in-game counter shows your running total.

actionSteps: Open the activities list as new areas unlock.
Start and finish one of each of the 9 types.
The trophy pops on the ninth type.
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.walkthrough: Leonida has 9 activity types — racing, fishing, shooting ranges, drone races, arcade games, bowling, golf, darts and the rest of the leisure set — and this trophy just needs one try of each. You do not need to win or score well; starting the activity and finishing it once is enough. The activities unlock as the story opens new areas, so sample them as you go.

actionSteps: Visit a Shooting Range venue (12 total).
Play each challenge until you earn gold.
Repeat across all 42 challenges.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.walkthrough: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges spread across 12 venues, and this silver needs a gold medal in every one. Each challenge scores accuracy and time, so use the weapon the range asks for, aim for headshots, and restart a challenge the moment a run goes bad — retries are free. Clear one venue at a time; the venue list shows which challenges are still short of gold.

actionSteps: Find a Top Fun drone race location.
Win the race at that location.
Repeat until all 14 locations show a win.
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.walkthrough: Top Fun runs drone races at 14 locations around Leonida, and this trophy needs a win at each one. Drone handling is about smooth lines through the gates, not top speed — cut corners tight and avoid the walls, since a crash costs more time than a cautious line. The race list shows which locations you have already won.

actionSteps: Enter races across street, off-road, boat and air.
Win each race; track which ones are done.
Reach 20 different race wins.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.walkthrough: Twenty different races must be won — repeats of the same race do not count twice. Leonida's race scene covers street, off-road, boat and air events, so mix vehicle types and keep a list of the ones you have already won. Each race pays cash too, which feeds the money trophies.

actionSteps: Go fishing and find Cal's challenge.
Use good bait and reel steadily.
Beat Cal's catch to win the challenge.
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.walkthrough: Cal is the fishing rival: challenge him at a fishing spot and out-fish him. The challenge is scored on the catch, so use the best rod and bait you have and reel steadily — jerky reeling snaps the line and loses the fish. Win one challenge against Cal and the trophy pops.

actionSteps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play the game to its end.
The trophy pops on completion.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.walkthrough: Arcades around Leonida hold playable cabinets, and finishing any one game earns this. Pick a cabinet, play it to its end — most are short, a few minutes at most — and the trophy pops when the game completes. It also counts toward trying all 9 activity types.

actionSteps: Take Andy's missions as they appear.
Play the strand through in order.
Complete Andy's final mission.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.walkthrough: Andy is one of the six character strands. His missions unlock as the story advances; take each one when its marker appears and play the strand through to its finale. The trophy pops when Andy's final mission completes. None of the strand finales is missable.

actionSteps: Take Kenton's missions as they appear.
Play the strand through in order.
Complete Kenton's final mission.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.walkthrough: Kenton is one of the six character strands, and his missions involve boats and the water. Take each Kenton mission when its marker appears and play the strand through to its finale. The trophy pops when Kenton's final mission completes.

actionSteps: Take Billy's missions as they appear.
Play the strand through in order.
Complete Billy's final mission.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.walkthrough: Billy is one of the six character strands, a biker strand. His missions unlock as the story advances; take each one when its marker appears and ride the strand through to its finale. The trophy pops when Billy's final mission completes.

actionSteps: Explore Leonida and take stranger missions.
Play each stranger strand to its end.
Complete 8 full stranger strands.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.walkthrough: Beyond the six named characters, Leonida has stranger missions — odd jobs from people you meet in the world. Eight full stranger strands must be completed for this silver. Strangers appear as markers while exploring, so sweep each region and take every stranger mission you find; the strand counter tracks how many are finished.

actionSteps: Take Randy's missions as they appear.
Play the strand through in order.
Complete Randy's final mission.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.walkthrough: Randy is one of the six character strands. His missions unlock as the story advances; take each one when its marker appears and play the strand through to its finale. The trophy pops when Randy's final mission completes.

actionSteps: Take Tyrone's missions as they appear.
Play the strand through in order.
Complete Tyrone's final mission.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.walkthrough: Tyrone is one of the six character strands. His missions unlock as the story advances; take each one when its marker appears and play the strand through to its finale. The trophy pops when Tyrone's final mission completes.

actionSteps: In Chapter 1, complete Down to Earth.
Go to the balcony at Jason's house and meditate with Lucia.
Visit the remaining spots (18 total, 15 needed for 100%).

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.walkthrough: This is the game's only missable trophy, so do it in Chapter 1: right after completing Down to Earth, go to the balcony at Jason's house and meditate with Lucia. That one Chapter 1 encounter cannot be revisited once the story moves on. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations and 100% needs 15, so after the balcony, work the other 17 spots at your own pace.

actionSteps: Take Bret's missions as they appear.
Follow the hunt and track the unique animal.
Take the shot and complete the hunt.
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.walkthrough: Bret is one of the six character strands, and his finale is a hunt for a unique animal. Take Bret's missions as they appear, then follow the hunt: track the animal through its territory, stay downwind and quiet, and take the shot when it is clean. The trophy pops when the hunt completes.

actionSteps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore.
Check the collection screen for missing cards.
Complete 3 full card sets.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.walkthrough: Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida in packs, and a set completes when every card in it is found. This silver needs 3 full sets. Cards sit in shops, houses and odd corners, so check every interior you enter and use the map to sweep a region at a time; the collection screen shows which sets are still missing cards.

actionSteps: Find WAiNK spots on the map while sweeping regions.
Trigger the WAiNK interaction at each spot.
Reach 100 WAINK spots.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.walkthrough: WAiNK spots are marked locations where you can trigger the WAiNK interaction, and this silver needs 100 of them. They are spread across all of Leonida, so the efficient route is to hit them during the map sweep for The Goodtime State — one region at a time, WAINK at every marked spot you pass. The counter tracks your total.

actionSteps: Open the challenge list.
Complete the easiest nearby challenges.
Reach 50 completed challenges.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.walkthrough: Challenges are the game's small goals — driving feats, combat feats, exploration feats — and this trophy needs 50 of them done. They complete naturally while playing, but the challenge list shows exactly which ones are close, so pick off the easy ones (short drives, simple takedowns) to reach 50 fast. Most players clear this during the stunt and race phases.

actionSteps: Get your partner in the car with you.
Raise a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and lose the heat together.
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.walkthrough: You need a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then you must lose the heat together. Build the wanted level with your partner in the car — cause chaos until the fourth star appears — then break line of sight, hide in alleys or the countryside, and wait for the stars to clear while your partner stays with you. If your partner leaves or is lost, it does not count.

actionSteps: Bring your partner and pick 3 nearby shops.
Rob the first shop, then the next two in a row.
Keep the same wanted level through all three.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.walkthrough: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, and keep the same wanted level through all three — losing the heat or getting busted resets the chain. Pick three shops close together, rob each quickly, and move fast between them so the wanted level never clears. A fast getaway car parked outside each shop helps.

actionSteps: Drive a different vehicle every time you travel.
Steal unusual or rare models when you see them.
Reach 100 distinct vehicles discovered.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.walkthrough: One hundred distinct vehicles must be discovered — getting in and driving a new model counts it. Leonida's traffic is varied, so the count climbs fast if you steal a different car every time you need one instead of reusing the same ride. Rare and special vehicles count too, so grab anything unusual you see; the vehicle list shows what is still missing.

actionSteps: Get 5 or more enemies in view.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Down all 5 before the meter runs out.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.walkthrough: Combat Focus slows time, and this trophy needs 5 enemies downed in a single use of it. The easiest setup is a wanted level with police closing in: trigger Combat Focus when five or more enemies are in view, then pick them off quickly before the meter runs out. A busy shootout or a gang hideout works too.

actionSteps: Get onto the VCIA airfield.
Steal a plane on the runway.
Take off and leave the airport.
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA in an unscheduled way.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.walkthrough: VCIA is the airport, and an unscheduled departure means leaving it in a vehicle that is not supposed to fly out — steal a plane on the runway and take off. Get onto the airfield, grab a plane, and get airborne; the trophy pops once you are up and away from the airport.

actionSteps: Raise a 5-star wanted level.
Let the Rhino tanks arrive.
Survive and fight through the encounter.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.walkthrough: Rhinos are the military tanks, and they roll in at high wanted levels. Survive an encounter with them — the trophy is about dealing with the tanks, so get to a 5-star wanted level, let the Rhinos arrive, and stay alive and fighting long enough for the encounter to register. Use cover and keep moving; a tank shell ends the run fast.

actionSteps: Pick a jewelry store and go at night.
Avoid cameras and staff sightlines.
Take the goods and leave undetected.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.walkthrough: A jewelry store robbery done clean: get in, take the goods, and get out without any alarm or detection. Go at night, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and move quietly — a silenced approach and a quick exit are the whole trick. If anyone spots you, leave and try again; the trophy only counts a fully undetected run.

actionSteps: Find a bank with a vault.
Rob the vault and grab the cash.
Escape cleanly; repeat for 5 vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.walkthrough: Five bank vaults must be robbed and escaped from, and this is a silver because each one is a full job: get in, crack the vault, grab the cash, and lose the heat. Banks are spread across Leonida, so plan a route and hit one at a time with a fast getaway car ready. Escaping cleanly is what counts — getting caught after the vault does not count.

actionSteps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it and crack it open.
Take the cash and escape.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.walkthrough: Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida. Stop one — ram it, block the road, or force the driver out — then crack it open and take the cash. The escort and the police will respond, so have a getaway car ready and lose the heat after the grab. One clean truck robbery and escape earns the trophy.

actionSteps: Open the map and note the unexplored zones.
Sweep one region at a time until revealed.
Visit all 52 zones.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.walkthrough: Leonida is divided into 52 map zones, and this trophy needs all of them visited. The map greys out unexplored zones, so the efficient route is a systematic sweep: drive or fly through one region at a time until every zone is revealed. Combine it with the WAINK spots and the collectible cards, which are spread through the same zones.

actionSteps: Find an illegal operation in a gang territory.
Rob the operation.
Repeat for all 9 gangs.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.walkthrough: Nine gangs run illegal operations across Leonida, and this trophy needs one operation robbed from each gang. Each gang holds a territory, so the job is to find their operation in each territory, hit it, and get out. The gang list shows which ones you have already hit, so work through the nine one at a time.

actionSteps: Go to the bar on Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail.
The trophy pops when the drink is served.
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.walkthrough: On Ocean Beach there is a bar with a view, and this trophy is simply about ordering a cocktail there. Walk into the bar, order the drink, and enjoy the view — the trophy pops once the cocktail is served. It is one of the relaxed one-off trophies, best done while sweeping the beach area for other collectibles.

actionSteps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Build speed on the street outside.
Smash through the showroom front.
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in style.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.walkthrough: A vehicle showroom has a big glass front, and the classic move is to drive straight through it. Take a car, build speed on the street outside, and smash through the showroom window in style. The trophy pops on the exit — it is a one-off stunt, so pick a fast car and a clear run-up.

actionSteps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game of bowling.
Play it through to the end.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.walkthrough: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is a playable activity. Go in, start a game, and follow through — play the game to its end and the trophy pops. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so it also counts toward trying them all.

actionSteps: Play a partner activity in a public place.
Perform well enough to draw a crowd.
The trophy pops on the crowd reaction.
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.walkthrough: This is a partnership moment: do something with your partner that draws a crowd. The trigger is a shared activity done well in public — the game tracks the moment, so play a partner activity (a race, a stunt, a showpiece) and the trophy pops when the crowd reacts. It is a story-adjacent one-off, so it comes naturally while playing with your partner.

actionSteps: Play missions and make dialogue choices.
Take free-roam encounters that offer decisions.
Reach 500 tracked choices.
trophies.guide: Make choices (PSN tracks a count to 500).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.walkthrough: This trophy tracks choices — the game counts decisions you make, and the count runs to 500. Choices appear in missions, dialogue and free-roam encounters, so it accumulates across the whole playthrough. There is no single trigger; just keep playing and making decisions, and the trophy pops when the count hits 500.

actionSteps: Attempt a race or challenge and fail it.
Retry immediately.
Win on the second try.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.walkthrough: Second time's the charm: fail something, then succeed on the immediate retry. The cleanest way is a short activity — fail a race or a challenge once, then win it on the next attempt. The trophy pops on the successful second try, so do not reload a save in between; the retry must follow the failure directly.

actionSteps: Explore remote or odd spots, often at night.
Trigger a strange event.
The trophy pops when you witness it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.walkthrough: Leonida hides strange events — odd sights in remote places — and witnessing one earns this. The events are tied to specific spots, often at night or in the wilderness, so explore the odd corners of the map and keep an eye out for anything that does not belong. One witnessed event is enough.

actionSteps: Get a melee weapon and a car.
Drive slowly past a pedestrian.
Swing the melee weapon as you pass and land the hit.
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.walkthrough: A melee drive-by means hitting someone with a melee weapon while driving past. Get a melee weapon, drive slowly past a pedestrian, and swing as you pass — the hit needs to connect while you are in the vehicle. One clean knockdown earns the trophy; a quiet street makes it easier than a crowded one.

actionSteps: Earn Marked Bills from heists and robberies.
Hand them to your contacts to launder.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.walkthrough: Marked Bills are dirty cash earned from heists and robberies, and contacts launder them into clean money. The trophy needs $250,000 laundered in total. Keep robbing and heisting, then hand the marked bills to your contacts regularly — the laundered total accumulates across the whole playthrough, so it is a matter of volume.

actionSteps: Buy weapons, clothes and vehicles as you play.
Spend across different shop types.
Reach $100,000 spent in total.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.walkthrough: One hundred thousand dollars must be spent across all shops — clothes, weapons, cars, food, anything the shops sell. It accumulates across the whole playthrough, so just buy what you need and the total climbs; weapons and vehicles are the fastest way to push it up. Check the stats page for the running total.

actionSteps: Find garage property markers on the map.
Save up and buy each garage.
Own all 8 garage properties.

citations.name: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.walkthrough: There are 8 garage properties for sale across Leonida, and this trophy needs all of them bought. Garages appear on the map as property markers; each costs money, so save up and buy them as you find them. They also give you storage for the vehicles you collect, which helps Whip It Good and On the Spot.

actionSteps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register a vehicle you own.
Repeat for 10 distinct vehicles.
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.walkthrough: The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles, and this trophy needs 10 registered. Drive a vehicle you own (or one you have just acquired) and register it through the app — each distinct vehicle counts once. Ten different vehicles, registered one at a time, and the trophy pops.
